chunks: And with this chain of narration, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
The best food of the people of this world and the Hereafter is meat, then rice.
ai.seo_question: What is considered the best food in Islam according to the Prophet?
ai.summary: In this tradition from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) elevates meat to the status of the 'master of food' for both this world and the Hereafter, highlighting its spiritual and physical sustenance. This ranking is immediately followed by rice (al-urz), indicating a hierarchy of nourishment that balances worldly vitality with eternal reward, a perspective often cited in Shia dietary jurisprudence to emphasize the merit of high-quality provisions.
